name: Default Guest Scoring Rubric
description: Edit the criteria/weights below to match your show's niche. Weights must sum to max_score.

criteria.label: Authority & Credibility
criteria.guidance: Citations, press coverage, published work, recognized credentials, notable prior media appearances.

criteria.label: Audience Reach
criteria.guidance: Follower counts, newsletter/email list size, notable platforms or communities they can bring listeners from.

criteria.label: Topical Fit for This Show
criteria.guidance: How directly relevant their expertise/opinions are to THIS show's specific niche and audience (e.g. hands-on AI experience, strong opinionated take, operator not just observer).

criteria.label: Recency & Momentum
criteria.guidance: Recent launch, recent funding, recent founder status, trending topic tie-in — makes the episode timely and shareable.

criteria.label: Pitch Quality Signal
criteria.guidance: Specific, well-researched pitch with concrete proposed talking points vs. generic copy-paste outreach.
